agreements: The complete RML paper design remains the intended long-horizon design: rendered causal world-lives, a frozen THINK/DREAM/SLEEP organism, text/graph/LoRA access views, common-deck attribution, later three-pack confirmation, and still-later randomized on-policy testing with clause-by-clause claim narrowing.

RML is only a candidate paper-facing instrument. Neither this proposal nor a one-pack DEV or CPU pass establishes a paper-ready benchmark, post-native developmental growth, autonomous discovery, LoRA value, baseline saturation, or an action-experience flywheel.

The present all-stage v1 scope is not an exact releasable implementation scope because the CPU instrument is not executable from bound bytes and the later model and LoRA stages contain material choices that do not yet exist.

The highest-information successor is one finite local CPU-only RML-D0 fluid/thermal reference pack that can falsify deterministic world validity, connected J necessity, prospective P necessity, leakage, oracle headroom, twin collision, growth, and evaluation isolation without any model call.

R, N, and O may remain inexpensive diagnostic strata in D0, while exact connected J and prospective P are the indispensable D0 constructs; X/revision is preserved in the full design but deferred from D0.

D0 should use complete model-independent causal-unit or era cuts. The actual model, tokenizer, chat template, reserves, complete-event L_native calculation, and recertification at 0.5x/2x/4x/8x belong to the later predecessor-bound gold/text release.
Evaluation must be a one-way disposable branch from a source snapshot into a write-denied clone and then an audit-only sink; there may be no feedback edge into the source life.

Gold/text model work and LoRA transport each require a new predecessor-bound, hash-bound architecture change, fresh independent review, and exact human ratification. Passing D0 cannot release either stage.

All current and successor artifacts remain non-claim evidence and must stop at a human boundary; no locked, on-policy, additional-pack, scale, publication, external-action, credential, lease, quota, or spend authority is implied.

disagreements.issue: Whether the current v1 may release a staged CPU-to-model-to-LoRA program, or must release nothing and be replaced by a CPU-only successor.

positions.position: One exact ratification may authorize the CPU world and harness, later gold-thinker and learned-text DEV model calls after CPU/review gates, and conditional same-corpus LoRA transport after text gates.

The present authority is too broad: material model, prompt, reader, baseline, provider, corpus, and LoRA bytes do not exist, and a later technical review cannot substitute for exact human ratification of those new choices.
The v1 chain should release nothing. A new v2 should request one exact CPU-only RML-D0 package, followed by separate predecessor-bound gold/text and LoRA proposals if earlier evidence warrants them.

resolution.rationale: The governance contract requires material architecture and scientific bytes to exist before exact human ratification, and the current CPU benchmark itself is also underspecified. Stage guards cannot make absent future bytes exact. Separating D0, gold/text, and LoRA creates genuine evidence-dependent stopping decisions without changing the full RML paper design.
resolution.selected_position: Select the cross-critique position: v1 releases no implementation, testing, analysis run, model call, GPU call, or training atom; rework into a CPU-only v2 proposal.
resolution.required_change: Create a newly hash-bound RML v2 change and scope that request only local CPU implementation, testing, and sealed analysis of the exact D0 reference pack. Prove model, tokenizer runtime, provider, GPU, trainer, adapter, LoRA, locked, on-policy, additional-pack, claim, publication, external-action, credential, quota, lease, and spend routes unreachable. Require a new predecessor-bound human release for exact gold/text work and another after frozen text evidence for exact LoRA work.

disagreements.issue: Whether CPU-D0 must include X/revision and model-native token cuts, or should isolate the smaller J/P world-validity core on model-independent causal-unit cuts.

positions.position: The CPU gate certifies R/N/O/J/P/X across 0.5x/2x/4x/8x L_native, including exception, backtracking, analogous recovery, and revision mechanics.
The native axis is undefined until a model stack is frozen; if feasibility is poor, the first pack should narrow to connected J plus one prospective P law while preserving controls.

D0 should keep R/N/O as diagnostics, require exact J and P, defer X as a separable revision construct, and validate complete causal-unit or era cuts; a later model release should project and recertify actual L_native cuts.

resolution.rationale: Connected J and unwitnessed-but-schema-supported P are sufficient to test the core RML instrument headroom. X adds exception diagnosis, information gathering, backtracking, analogous-target sealing, and correction dynamics. Binding an otherwise unused model only to size a CPU world would prematurely couple the reference instrument to an unselected model and could make D0 unbounded.
resolution.selected_position: Use the critique's minimal D0: fluid/thermal R/N/O diagnostics plus indispensable J and P on fixed causal-unit or era cuts; preserve but defer X and the actual native-context schedule.
resolution.required_change: The v2 D0 package must define interval cuts in complete causal units or eras and require each interval to add fixed minimum unique public roots, locally identifiable relations, an old/new interaction, and a prospectively committed prediction. It must contain no X target, exception-specific recovery system, analogous-revision metric, correction-half-life metric, or revision claim. The later gold/text bundle must bind the exact model/tokenizer/template/reserves, compute complete-event 0.5x/2x/4x/8x L_native cuts with three genuinely post-native cuts, and rerun growth, twin, leakage, solvability, and J/P necessity certification before the first model call.

disagreements.issue: Whether the current prose and generic CPU tests determine a reproducible RML reference instrument, or whether an exact but tightly scoped D0 execution package is required before coding.

positions.position: The fluid/thermal description, target classes, oracle/leakage thresholds, twins, necessity requirements, and acceptance tests are sufficient to begin CPU implementation.

Implementers would still have to choose the world DSL and prior, serialization and renderer, source schedule, target/twin constructors, legal planner and scorer, accepted-item selection, seeds/cardinalities, workflow, artifacts, and CPU limits; those choices define the benchmark.

One successor CPU execution package should bind only the indispensable world/deck, J/P certificate, Bayes/oracle, visibility/isolation, deterministic evidence, cardinality, entry-point, and resource mechanics; future cognition and transport contracts must not be pulled into D0.

resolution.rationale: The CPU package cannot be implemented without silently designing its scientific behavior, but exactness does not require D0 to settle components it does not execute. One compact execution package is the minimal faithful repair.
resolution.selected_position: Require one exact CPU-only D0 execution package with no model-facing additions.
resolution.required_change: Hash-bind in v2: (1) the fluid/thermal persistent state, typed action, ordinary outcome, cost, legality, termination, causal-program grammar/prior, renderer, and canonical byte schemas with goldens; (2) the frozen target-blind and outcome-blind nonexhaustive source schedule and causal-unit/era growth rules; (3) exact R/N/O diagnostics and per-target J bridge deletion/recent-only/early-only failure plus P pretarget schema commitment and atoms-without-schema/witnessed-graph ceiling; (4) target/twin construction, complete pre-action target-visible byte collision with different correct plans, structural rejection, seeds, pair/target cardinalities, and no-replacement rules; (5) legal-plan enumeration, action-value/scoring/failure rules, legal-history oracle, exact accepted-item generator-aware no-life Bayes conditioning and aggregation, authentic-history twin identification, and declared shortcut probes; and (6) a local CPU source/test/schema allowlist, one entry command, deterministic sealed artifact manifest, and finite wall/RSS/disk/worker ceilings. Do not add THINK, DREAM, SLEEP text compilation, model readers, model baselines, providers, adapters, or LoRA to D0.

disagreements.issue: Whether the four-stage visibility matrix and a gold/text-to-CPU isolation edge are an adequate CPU firewall and executable graph.

positions.position: The THINK/DREAM/SLEEP/scorer matrix and backward isolation edge express the intended prohibition on target feedback and evaluation mutation.
The edge creates a cycle and the matrix omits the actual CPU processes and distinct source, target, selection, pairing, proof, and score fields needed for an enforceable firewall.

D0 should bind only its real CPU process/store visibility and a one-way SourceLifeSnapshot to write-denied EvaluationClone to AuditOnlySink branch; the full reader/provider/trainer matrix belongs to the later model release.

resolution.rationale: A predecessor graph cannot also contain a downstream feedback edge. CPU validity depends on exact capabilities of the processes that generate, select, solve, score, and audit the reference pack, but it does not depend on future model-backend fields.
resolution.selected_position: Adopt the critique's CPU-only firewall and acyclic disposable-evaluation branch.
resolution.required_change: Replace the backward edge with SourceLifeSnapshot -> write-denied EvaluationClone -> AuditOnlySink and prohibit every write-back path. Bind canonical public, hidden, selection/pairing, proof, score, and audit records plus exact inputs, outputs, capabilities, and exclusive writers for the D0 environment/generator, source policy, accepted-world selector, target/twin constructor, legal planner, no-life Bayes controller, evaluator, scorer, audit sink, and evidence supervisor. Require complete target-visible twin byte collision and run-versus-skip equality of source state, event log, RNG state, suffix, and later evidence hashes. Defer THINK support-handle semantics and reader/candidate/provider/cache/timing/error/compiler/baseline/trainer/adapter/reporting cells to the exact gold/text or LoRA bundle that introduces them.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposal's declared later gates and fresh review are sufficient, or whether exact model/text and LoRA contracts need separate predecessor-bound human releases.

positions.position: After CPU and review pass, the existing scope may run gold-thinker and learned-text DEV calls, then LoRA if RML05 and RML06 thresholds pass.

Gold gain math, writer validity, honest native baselines, resolver interfaces, stability, and LoRA clean-base/candidate-work/unaided-read contracts are not bound and cannot be inferred from downstream scores.
The tests are mistimed for actual transitions, and models, prompts, readers, baselines, decks, provider behavior, resources, and LoRA recipes are material choices requiring new exact human authority.
Those are valid requirements for later releases but irrelevant to CPU-D0; freeze them only after predecessor D0 or learned-text evidence exists.

resolution.rationale: Later model and transport details materially determine post-native status, information bandwidth, baseline fairness, gate values, and attribution. They must be exact before use, but forcing them into D0 would broaden and slow the most informative CPU falsification step.
resolution.selected_position: Defer all model and transport choices to two later predecessor-bound bundles and require exact stage guards there.
resolution.required_change: After D0 evidence is frozen, a new gold/text change must bind the exact model and tokenizer revisions, chat template, prompt/state/workspace/output reserves, complete-event native cuts, THINK/DREAM prompts and schemas, reader return bytes and caps, gold construction, writer-validity/chronology/prospective panels, controller and generation configurations, DEV decks/seeds/call counts, honest native baseline versions and native/common interfaces, gate equations and edge cases, stability rule, provider durability, and finite model/GPU/resource ceilings; it must recertify the D0 stream at all selected native cuts before any call. Only after sealed learned-text evidence passes may a separate LoRA change bind the identical admitted corpus, clean base and direct-QA controls, assisted and strict unaided queries/parsers, candidate work, rank/capacity, seeds, recipe, training durability, budgets, and terminal no-promotion rule. RML05 and RML06 must guard the first LoRA dispatch, and RML07 must terminate transport. None of these bytes or actions belongs in v2 D0.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposal's general DEV firewall is sufficient, or whether stage-specific language must prevent fixed-deck and bundled-pipeline results from being overstated.

positions.position: The one-pack DEV claim firewall already limits outputs to protocol fidelity, gate values, failures, and resource observations while preserving the conditional future paper claim.

A supplied fixed deck cannot support experiential-learning or flywheel language, a DREAM/SLEEP text score cannot separate autonomous discovery from bundled compilation, and one pack cannot validate the paper benchmark or growth.
D0 needs a literal stage-accurate linter, while the complete conditional RML claim ladder remains preserved for later separately authorized evidence.

resolution.rationale: The proposal states the right broad principle, but stage-specific forbidden terms make the boundary auditable and preserve attribution. Narrowing present claims does not retire the full design; it prevents design selection and pilot conformance from being reported as empirical confirmation.
resolution.selected_position: Keep the full conditional paper design and enforce a stricter D0 and fixed-deck vocabulary.
resolution.required_change: From v2 D0 onward reject language asserting a validated benchmark, paper result, post-native or developmental growth, developmental experiential learning, autonomous discovery, DREAM necessity, recurrent SLEEP benefit, revision/correction, LoRA superiority or retained value, baseline saturation, population generality, or a memory-action-experience flywheel unless its separately ratified evidence exists. D0 may report only deterministic one-pack instrument conformance, failures, and CPU resources. A later fixed-deck one-pack result may report only experience-conditioned representation/use and constructive later action with bundled-pipeline credit. Preserve graph/program/text wins and learned-text/LoRA losses as legitimate narrowing outcomes, and preserve the future three-pack, weights, and on-policy claim clauses only behind their original evidence gates.

disagreements.issue: How much resource and crash behavior must be bound in D0 without importing future provider and training machinery.

positions.position: A bounded CPU performance/resource prototype is necessary because exact planning, twins, prospective targets, and long streams may otherwise create an open-ended pilot.
All three loops need crash-at-seal, provider recovery, partial quarantine, training resume, terminal markers, and numeric CPU/model/GPU/training ceilings.
D0 needs only a finite deterministic CPU workflow/evidence envelope; provider-call and adapter-training durability belong to the later bundles that introduce those operations.

resolution.rationale: D0 must fail closed and be reproducible under finite local resources, but it has no model dispatch or training to recover. Requiring future operational machinery now would broaden D0 without improving its scientific falsification value.
resolution.selected_position: Bind a small deterministic CPU execution envelope in D0 and defer provider/training durability with the corresponding later stages.
resolution.required_change: V2 D0 must state finite CPU wall time, RSS, disk, worker, generated-pair/target, rejection-attempt, and planner-search ceilings; stop and fail rather than weaken filters or expand them. Bind canonical inputs and manifests, atomic finalization, an explicit incomplete/invalid state, and clean-rerun byte equality so partial outputs cannot count as evidence. Do not require provider dispatch recovery, model-call deduplication, GPU envelopes, adapter checkpoints, or training resume in D0; bind and fault-test those only in the later gold/text or LoRA release.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current scope conditionally releases future model and LoRA stages before their material bytes exist. Technical review is necessary but cannot provide exact human ratification for later-created architecture and scientific choices.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Release nothing under v1. Replace it with CPU-only v2 D0, then require a predecessor-bound exact gold/text release and, only after frozen passing text evidence, a separate exact LoRA release.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The absent world, stream, target, twin, planner, scorer, Bayes, cardinality, artifact, entry-point, and finite-resource contracts define the instrument and cannot be left to implementation judgment.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the single minimal CPU execution package enumerated in CONS_D03; do not add model prompts, readers, native model baselines, provider behavior, model statistics, or LoRA mechanics.

concern_dispositions.rationale: X is valuable to the full paper design but is a separable exception/revision construct. Exact J and P provide the first reference pack's necessary connected and prospective headroom.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Exclude X, exception-specific mechanics, analogous recovery, correction metrics, and revision claims from D0 while preserving them for a later predecessor-bound rung.

concern_dispositions.rationale: No model is used in D0, and binding one only to choose world length would prematurely couple CPU feasibility to an unselected stack. Model-independent cuts retain exact growth requirements.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use complete causal-unit or era cuts in D0. Bind the actual model-native cut procedure and rerun all cut-level CPU certificates in the later gold/text release before any model call.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The backward edge contradicts the predecessor graph and misrepresents a noninterference assertion as feedback.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use the one-way SourceLifeSnapshot -> write-denied EvaluationClone -> AuditOnlySink branch with no write-back path and exact run-versus-skip source hash equality.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The existing matrix omits CPU processes that can leak selection, pairing, proof, or score information, but future model processes are outside D0 and should not enlarge its contract.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind exact stores, records, capabilities, and exclusive writers for every actual D0 CPU process; defer model reader, candidate, provider, cache/timing/error, trainer, adapter, and reporting cells to later releases.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The accepted-item prior, visible conditioning record, target cardinalities, aggregation, degenerate cases, and failure conventions determine both no-life Bayes value and oracle headroom.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify exact accepted-item Bayes and oracle inputs, selection conditioning, per-target and per-stratum formulas, cardinalities, authentic-history twin measure, and degenerate/rejection/unsolvable failure rules in v2 D0.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A scripted common deck cannot show memory-directed experience acquisition, and D0 shows only instrument conformance. Bundled writer/compiler/reader/thinker outcomes also cannot support autonomous organ credit.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add the stage-accurate semantic firewall in CONS_D06 while retaining the complete conditional RML paper design behind future evidence and authority.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: CPU-D0, gold/text, and LoRA contain different material choices and predecessor evidence and should be separate release decisions.
The common deck holds experience fixed, so it tests experience-conditioned representation/use and later action, not memory-directed experiential acquisition or the flywheel.
D0 must bind exhaustive per-target J and P certificates and fail individual uncertified targets rather than rely on cohort averages.
The ambiguity is real, but the model stack should not be bound in CPU-D0. It must be bound in the later gold/text release, which then projects and recertifies native cuts before any call.

D0 needs pretarget P commitment and an atoms-without-schema/witnessed-graph ceiling. Learned-writer, descriptor-binding shuffle, held-out-production generalization, and post-outcome leak controls belong to the later model release rather than D0.
Baseline versions, knowledge, capacities, native interfaces, common interfaces, and resources must be exact before model calls, but are not CPU-D0 requirements.
A downstream text score cannot validate proposal quality or chronology. The exact writer-validity gate is required in the later learned-text release and is deliberately excluded from D0.
The current learned-text arm supports bundled-pipeline credit only; any DREAM, SLEEP, recurrence, or autonomous-discovery credit requires later exact controls and claims.
Text pass manifests must guard LoRA dispatch, and clean-base, direct-QA, candidate-work, capacity, assisted/unaided, and recipe contracts require a separate post-text release.
Later model gates need exact denominators, nested-unit treatment, per-pair/stratum reporting, repeatability or conservative stability rules, and non-population language; these are not D0 CPU choices.

D0 needs finite CPU counts and resource ceilings and should defer X. Full model-call, writer, baseline, and adapter costing belongs to later bundles, so it must not block the narrower CPU reference pack.
The world/deck/controller/scorer/evidence choices are material CPU benchmark bytes. A single compact D0 execution package is required before implementation.
Later-created model and LoRA choices require new predecessor-bound exact human releases; v1's broad conditional authority is not sufficient.
Evaluation is a write-denied disposable branch and audit assertion, not a reverse dependency into source generation.

D0 must bind a full field-level firewall for its actual CPU processes. Model reader, candidate, provider, timing/error/cache, trainer, adapter, and report paths are deferred to the release that introduces them.

D0 requires finite CPU ceilings, atomic finalization, incomplete-output invalidation, and deterministic clean reruns. Provider recovery and training-resume rules are future-stage requirements and must not broaden D0.
The later workflows must make RML05/RML06 prerequisites to LoRA, RML07 terminal, and the scope/claim firewall active at all entries and exits; no such stage is released by v1.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: The invariant is valid and currently demonstrates failure: the v1 scope is too broad and the stage graph is not executable. Consensus cannot replace its registry; v2 must register a new CPU-only exact-scope test that proves every model/GPU/training and forbidden route unreachable.

The full RML design still requires this property, including later X and actual native cuts, so the v1 test is not deleted. It is insufficient for D0 as written: v2 must separately register a causal-unit R/N/O/J/P test with X exclusion, exact per-target certificates, and later native-cut recertification.

Oracle headroom and no-life/leakage ceilings remain central. V2 must add an executable D0 test binding the accepted-item prior and visible conditioning set, exact cardinalities and aggregation, degenerate/failure rules, target-visible twin collision, and authentic-history identification.

The end-to-end firewall remains required for the full design. Before D0 coding, v2 must register a CPU-process/store capability test and the acyclic disposable-clone run/skip test; model-facing chronology and provenance portions wait for the later model bundle.

This remains a future full-design gate, but it is inaccessible under v1 and irrelevant to D0. Its exact controller, gold, reader, deck, metric, stability, causal-use, and stage-transition implementation must be newly registered in the predecessor-bound gold/text proposal.

This remains a future full-design gate, not D0 authority. The later model proposal must add the missing writer-validity and chronology gate, bind honest baseline implementations and interfaces, define gold-gain math and stability, and make the passing manifest a mechanical prerequisite to LoRA.

Same-corpus transport remains part of the full paper design, but no LoRA route is released now. A separate post-text proposal must bind the exact corpus, clean-base/direct-QA controls, assisted and unaided readers, candidate work, capacity, parser, recipe, seeds, durability, resources, and terminal stop test.

Fresh review over exact frozen bytes remains necessary for later model work, but is not sufficient human authority. Each later model or LoRA bundle also requires its own predecessor binding and exact human ratification.

The firewall remains valid but must become stage-accurate. V2 must register a D0 linter allowing only one-pack CPU instrument-conformance/failure/resource observations and forbidding X/revision, post-native, learned-memory, benchmark, developmental, LoRA, flywheel, promotion, and external-action language or routes.

Will Rohin preserve the full conditional RML paper design while treating a future green D0 only as one-pack instrument-conformance evidence and requiring separate exact human decisions for gold/text, LoRA, locked confirmation, and on-policy work?
